definitions.name: Tree canopy

accessibility.label: Tree canopy
accessibility.shortMechanism: Adds a bounded shade and vegetation proxy.

definitions.limitation: Time to mature, species, irrigation, soil volume, survival, and maintenance need local review.

evidence.title: NYSERDA comparative heat-island mitigation report
evidence.context: Supports comparative intervention context; it does not calibrate this synthetic grid.

responseEnvelope.lowLabel: Establishment conditions constrain the modeled influence
responseEnvelope.highLabel: Continuous, maintained canopy supports the stronger illustrative case
responseEnvelope.context: An illustrative relationship range, not a local temperature interval.

applicabilityPrompts: Is there adequate soil volume and irrigation?
Who will maintain the canopy through establishment?
Could the location improve shade without reducing accessible passage?

definitions.name: Shade structure
definitions.limitation: Structural feasibility, wind and snow loads, ownership, and accessibility need local review.

evidence.title: Shaded routing research
evidence.context: Provides a shaded-routing research context; it is not a construction recommendation.

responseEnvelope.highLabel: Continuous shade at the chosen time and use pattern
responseEnvelope.context: Illustrative shade coverage only; no temperature outcome is calculated.

applicabilityPrompts: Can it meet structural and accessibility requirements?
Who owns and maintains the space?
Does it shade the times people actually use the area?

definitions.name: Cool surface
definitions.limitation: Surface temperature is not air temperature, human exposure, or a guaranteed benefit.

evidence.title: NYSERDA comparative heat-island mitigation report
evidence.context: Supports a comparative surface-mitigation context; local material behavior remains unmodeled.

responseEnvelope.highLabel: Continuous maintained coverage on an appropriate surface
responseEnvelope.context: The envelope is a design-scope explanation, not a temperature prediction.

applicabilityPrompts: Is the surface appropriate for reflective treatment?
Could glare, traction, drainage, or maintenance create a tradeoff?
Who controls the surface and its upkeep?

definitions.name: Cool roof
definitions.limitation: Does not claim a pedestrian air-temperature or indoor-energy outcome.

evidence.title: NYSERDA comparative heat-island mitigation report
evidence.context: Provides a comparative light-roof context, not a site-specific roof assessment.

responseEnvelope.context: Illustrative roof-surface reasoning; it is not an energy model.

applicabilityPrompts: Is the roof eligible and structurally suitable?
What are the warranty, drainage, and maintenance constraints?
Who can authorize the work?

definitions.name: Cool pavement

accessibility.label: Cool pavement
accessibility.shortMechanism: Adds a conditional surface proxy along a route.

definitions.limitation: Surface temperature is not air temperature or human exposure; traffic and maintenance need review.

evidence.title: Cool pavement intervention catalog note
evidence.context: The canonical catalog marks cost evidence as ranking-only; this entry does not assert a procurement estimate.

responseEnvelope.highLabel: Continuous treatment after material and traffic review

applicabilityPrompts: Is the route appropriate for the material and traffic load?
Could glare, traction, drainage, or repair needs create a tradeoff?
Can the owner maintain the treatment?

definitions.name: Permeable paving
definitions.limitation: Requires hydrology, maintenance, traffic, and seasonal-suitability review.

evidence.title: Permeable paving intervention catalog note
evidence.context: The canonical catalog treats this as ranking-only context; local hydrology is not inferred.

responseEnvelope.lowLabel: Constrained by drainage, clogging, or seasonal conditions
responseEnvelope.context: Illustrative moisture relationship; the lab does not simulate hydrology.

applicabilityPrompts: Do local soils, drainage, and utilities support this use?
Who will manage sweeping, clogging, and repair?
Is the traffic and winter condition suitable?

definitions.name: Cooling-access node
definitions.limitation: Does not establish operational capacity, opening hours, safety, eligibility, or public access.

evidence.title: Low-cooling-access method
evidence.context: Documents the project's modeled cooling-access concepts; this synthetic node is not a verified facility.

responseEnvelope.lowLabel: Limited modeled connection to a hypothetical node
responseEnvelope.highLabel: Stronger modeled route continuity after local verification
responseEnvelope.context: This is not a prediction of person-level access.

applicabilityPrompts: Is there a verified public cooling option, with accessible hours?
Are safety, eligibility, cost, and language barriers understood?
Can the route be checked with community knowledge?
